title: Completed reduction augmentation compatibility for a normalized comparison
statement: Fix an adic coefficient datum d [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and a morphism f:Y→X, with the canonical completed module pullback F, strict tower pullback G, constant functors and exact derived constant-pullback square [def-weil-pbc-exact-pullback-interface]. Fix e:RX⋙G≅F⋙RY for the actual ordinary completed reduction tower functors and τ:LX⋙D(G)≅D(F)⋙LY for their actual derived functors. Suppose e preserves the chosen ordinary quotient units [def-weil-pbc-reduction-augmentation], τ satisfies the computing-counit equation [def-weil-pbc-derived-reduction-comparison-formula] on every K-flat source complex, and F sends flat-term K-flat source complexes to K-flat complexes. Then τ preserves the actual derived quotient augmentation, with the exact derived constant-pullback square and the fixed source D(F)K, for every K. No stratum or Noetherian hypothesis is required beyond the stated computing property.

proof.text: Take the resolving class of K-flat complexes with flat terms. Every source complex admits such a resolution; translate exactness of tensoring into the existing IsFlatOnSite predicate through the tensor-right isomorphism. The assumed pullback property makes the target reduction counit invertible on these pulled-back representatives.

The chosen derived augmentations are normalized by the fixed universal reduction counits. The complex form of each counit only inserts localization and homotopy-category identity factors, so removing those identities gives the required complex-counit unit equation. Apply the generic augmentation-of-counits theorem to the actual functors, e and τ, using this normalization, their assumed representative equation and the assumed ordinary augmented square.

theorem completedReduction_augmentationOfComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (e : completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor X d ⋙ d.towerModulePull f ≅
      proEtaleRingModulePullback f (d.completedRing X) (d.completedRing Y)
        (d.integralRingIso f) ⋙ completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor Y d)
    (τ : completedReductionTower X d ⋙ d.towerPull f ≅ d.pull f ⋙
      completedReductionTower Y d)
    (hOrd : ∀ M : reductionModules X (d.completedRing X),
      (d.towerModulePull f).map ((completedReductionModuleUnit d X).app M) ≫ e.hom.app M =
        (d.constantPullbackIso f).hom.app M ≫ (completedReductionModuleUnit d Y).app
          ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f (d.completedRing X) (d.completedRing Y)
            (d.integralRingIso f)).obj M))
    (hnorm : ∀ P : CochainComplex (reductionModules X (d.completedRing X)) ℤ,
      P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
      DerivedReductionComparisonFormula
        (proEtaleRingModulePullback f (d.completedRing X) (d.completedRing Y)
          (d.integralRingIso f)) (d.towerModulePull f)
        (completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor X d) (completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor Y d)
        (completedReductionTower X d) (completedReductionTower Y d)
        (completedReductionTowerComplexCounit X d) (completedReductionTowerComplexCounit Y d)
        e τ P)
    (hflat : ∀ P : CochainComplex (reductionModules X (d.completedRing X)) ℤ,
      P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
      (∀ n, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := ProEt.topology X)
        (R := d.completedRing X) (P.X n)) →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := d.completedRing Y)
        (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f (d.completedRing X) (d.completedRing Y)
          (d.integralRingIso f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (K : d.derived X) :
    (d.towerPull f).map ((completedReductionAugmentation d X).app K) ≫ τ.hom.app K =
      (d.derivedConstantPullbackIso f).hom.app K ≫
        (completedReductionAugmentation d Y).app ((d.pull f).obj K)
